exposure: learning about family planning from electronic media and before marriage
cohort: The study included 8287 women aged 15-49 years from Pakistan who participated in the 2017-18 Pakistan Demographic and Health Survey (PDHS).
finding: Education and household wealth status were identified as the strongest sociodemographic predictors of utilizing basic reproductive healthcare services, including ANC and facility delivery, among women in Pakistan.
mod_finding: The study found that 19.63% of women reported using C-section services, with sociodemographic factors influencing its preference.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from the 2017-18 Pakistan Demographic and Health Survey (PDHS).
